lines.text: I'm finally back on my feet.

data.define: Recovered and able to do normal things again.

example.text: I'm finally back on my feet.

misuse.text: Don't say 'back on my feet' about standing up.
misuse.why: It means healthy and active again.

data.l1_hook: Minggu lalu sakit, hari ini sudah 'back on my feet'!
data.l1_ex: Akhirnya aku sudah 'back on my feet'.

native.tip: “back on my feet” = sembuh kembali; kembali pulih. Contoh: “I'm finally back on my feet.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “back on my feet”?
“back on my feet” = sembuh kembali; kembali pulih.
Contoh: “I'm finally back on my feet.” (Akhirnya aku sudah 'back on my feet'.)
Belajar slang bahasa Inggris gratis di Lexkite.
